preconditions.description: The message must be a string.
The hashtag must be a string.

preconditions.expression: hashtag.startswith('#') and all(c.isalnum() for c in hashtag[1:])
preconditions.description: The hashtag must start with '#' and contain only alphanumeric characters after the '#'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == message.replace(hashtag, '', 1) if hashtag in message else message
postconditions.description: If the hashtag is present in the message, it is removed only once; otherwise, the message remains unchanged.
